description: This file contains unit tests for the MenuSessionsInjector functionality in a macOS application, focusing on menu item injection, positioning, and usage data integration.

classes.name: MenuSessionsInjectorTests
classes.description: A test suite for verifying the behavior of MenuSessionsInjector in various scenarios, including menu item positioning and injection of session and usage data.

methods.name: anchorsDynamicRowsBelowControlsAndActions
methods.description: Tests if the injector correctly finds the insertion index for dynamic session rows in the menu.

methods.name: injectsDisconnectedMessage
methods.description: Tests whether the injector correctly injects a disconnected status message into the menu when the control channel is not connected.

methods.name: injectsSessionRows
methods.description: Verifies that session rows are correctly injected into the menu, positioned relative to existing items.

methods.name: cost usage submenu does not use injector delegate
methods.description: Ensures that the 'Usage cost (30 days)' submenu is correctly created with no delegate assigned.
